## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are bounded and preserve unrelated work.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria have evidence; remaining gaps are explicit.
- [ ] Failure/cancellation paths and applicable data-safety rules are covered.
- [ ] Validation results are actual, and platform claims match evidence.
- [ ] Required approvals and directly affected documentation are included.
- [ ] No secrets, private user data, or unlicensed fixtures are included.
- [ ] Commit message follows Conventional Commits.
